name: node-opcua-modeler-mcp-server

tools.name: resolve_dependencies
tools.description: Given one or more companion spec namespace aliases, returns the full resolved dependency list that MUST go in the YAML `namespaces:` section. Always call this before generating the namespaces block.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List all well-known OPC UA companion spec namespace aliases with their full names, URIs, and dependencies. Use this to discover what namespaces are available.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: List ALL ObjectTypes, VariableTypes, and InterfaceTypes defined in a specific companion spec namespace. ALWAYS call this before using any type from a namespace — NEVER guess type names.

tools.name: get_type_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific type: its components, properties, methods, interfaces, and optional members. Use this to understand a type's structure before creating instances or subtypes. `specRef`, on the type and on a member, is the link to the section of the specification that defines it: cite it.

alias.description: Companion spec alias where the type is defined (e.g. "machinery")

tools.name: search_types
tools.description: Search for types across ALL companion specs by keyword. Use this when you don't know which namespace defines a type. Returns matching types with their namespace alias.

tools.name: find_reusable_block
tools.description: Find reusable Interfaces / AddIns by capability — pass a member name or keyword (e.g. "SerialNumber", "DeviceHealth", "Location") and get the standard blocks that already expose it. PREFER applying/composing an existing block over redefining its members inline. Interfaces are applied with `interfaces:`; addins (types with a DefaultInstanceBrowseName) are composed with `addIns:`. A single property → use the Interface; a whole named sub-object → use the AddIn.

tools.name: find_engineering_unit
tools.description: Find the official UNECE Rec. 20 engineering unit symbol for a given description. ALWAYS call this before using any engineering unit — NEVER guess unit symbols.

query.description: Description or common name of the unit (e.g. "revolutions per minute", "celsius", "pressure bar")

tools.name: get_dsl_reference
tools.description: Get the grammar reference for the OPC UA modeler YAML DSL: file header, top-level sections, name-prefix conventions, minimal examples, and common mistakes. Call this FIRST before writing any YAML model by hand. Works without an API key.

tools.name: opcua_model_validate
tools.description: Validate an OPC UA YAML model for correctness. Returns diagnostics with severity (error/warning/info), codes, messages, and line numbers. Works without an API key (limited to 50 calls/day). ALWAYS validate before generating.

yaml.description: The full YAML model source to validate

tools.name: opcua_model_generate
tools.description: Generate OPC UA NodeSet2.xml and the symbols CSV from a YAML model. Requires an API key (set OPCUA_MODELER_API_KEY env var). NodeIds stay stable only if each regeneration passes back the symbols of the previous one: pass symbols_csv, or mode "new" for a first generation, or mode "renumber" to change ids on purpose. A call with none of these is refused with SYMBOLS_DECISION_REQUIRED. Prefer model_path: the paired <name>.model.symbols.csv is then read automatically and the outputs are written beside the model, so nothing large passes through the conversation. The result lists symbol counts (reused/new/dropped), hints and next steps.

yaml.description: The full YAML model source. Prefer model_path when the model is a file.

symbols_csv.description: The symbols CSV of the previous generation (the content of <name>.model.symbols.csv, or the base64 symbols_csv a previous call returned). Keeps NodeIds stable.

mode.description: "new": first generation, no symbols yet. "update": regeneration, symbols required. "renumber": allocate new NodeIds on purpose. Omit when passing symbols.

include_docs.description: Set to true to include markdown documentation (slower)

model_path.description: Path to the model file. Its paired <name>.model.symbols.csv is read, and the outputs are written beside it as `opcua-modeler generate` writes them. Use instead of yaml.

output_dir.description: With model_path: write the outputs here instead of beside the model.

include_artifacts.description: With model_path: also return the artefacts inline (base64). Off by default: they are large.

tools.name: opcua_model_reverse
tools.description: Reverse-engineer a NodeSet2.xml file back into the YAML DSL format. Requires an API key (set OPCUA_MODELER_API_KEY env var). Optionally specify the target namespace URI to extract.

xml.description: The NodeSet2.xml content. Prefer xml_path for a file.

xml_path.description: Path to the NodeSet2.xml file: it is read here, and never passes through the conversation.

namespace_uri.description: Target namespace URI to extract (auto-detected if omitted)

self_contained.description: Return one self-contained .opcua.yaml stream: the model, its NodeId symbol table and dependency declarations (default: bare YAML)

tools.name: opcua_model_create
tools.description: Generate an OPC UA YAML model from a natural language description using AI. Requires an API key (set OPCUA_MODELER_API_KEY env var). The AI will auto-detect relevant companion specs, generate a validated model with documentation, and auto-correct validation errors.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the OPC UA model to generate
